1.consolidated_definition: Recogido por Del Rosario y Maura, alude a ‘quien se cree persona muy importante o superior a otros’. “Se va a criar creyéndose que es un Cuatro de Julio.” Malilyn Vicens, El Nuevo Día, “En Grande”, 22 de septiembre de 1996, p. 10.
1.en_consolidated_definition:
Person who believes themselves to be a very important or superior individual to others. 

Refers to "someone who thinks they are a big shot." Malilyn Vicens, El Nuevo Día, “En Grande”, 22 de septiembre de 1996, p. 10.

Note: The term 'Cuatro de Julio' is likely referring to the Puerto Rican holiday 'Día de la Independencia', which commemorates July 4th (Puerto Rico's Independence Day), but in this context it may be used as a colloquialism for someone who thinks they are superior.
